cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(HoroPhysicsSdkContract LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(HoroEngineGameplay REQUIRED)
if(TARGET HoroEngine::Physics OR TARGET HoroEngine::GameplayPhysicsIntegration)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The default gameplay SDK must remain Physics-free")
endif()
find_package(HoroEngineGameplay REQUIRED COMPONENTS Physics)
horo_add_gameplay_module(HoroPhysicsSdkModule MODULE_ID game.physics_sdk NO_MANIFEST SOURCES PhysicsModule.cpp)
target_link_libraries(HoroPhysicsSdkModule PRIVATE HoroEngine::GameplayPhysicsIntegration)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/artifact-$<CONFIG>.txt" CONTENT "$<TARGET_FILE:HoroPhysicsSdkModule>")
